headerAudits.name: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Missing HSTS exposes users to SSL Strip & MITM downgrade attacks.

headerAudits.name: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Missing CSP allows malicious Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data exfiltration.

headerAudits.name: X-Frame-Options
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Missing X-Frame-Options enables Clickjacking frame embedding attacks.

headerAudits.name: X-Content-Type-Options
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Missing nosniff allows browsers to MIME-sniff non-executable files into executable scripts.

headerAudits.name: Referrer-Policy
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Missing Referrer-Policy may leak sensitive internal URLs to third-party domains.

headerAudits.name: Server Header Disclosure
headerAudits.vulnerabilityMsg: Exposing backend server versions assists attackers in targeting specific CVE exploits.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
vulnerabilities.description: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS headers, leaving connections vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle attacks.
vulnerabilities.exploitVector: An attacker on a public Wi-Fi network can intercept HTTP requests before redirection and downgrade the user to unencrypted HTTP.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enable HSTS header with minimum max-age of 31536000 seconds (1 year) and includeSubDomains directive.
vulnerabilities.fixCode:
# Nginx Configuration
add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;

# Apache Configuration
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
vulnerabilities.description: No Content Security Policy header is specified. The browser cannot restrict script sources or object embeds.
vulnerabilities.exploitVector: Attacker injects inline JavaScript via stored/reflected XSS to siphon authorization tokens and session cookies.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement a strict Content Security Policy restricting script execution to authorized domains and trusted nonces.
vulnerabilities.fixCode:
# Nginx CSP Header
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:;" always;

vulnerabilities.title: Information Exposure: Backend Server Banner Exposed (gws)
vulnerabilities.description: The application leaks backend software version details (gws), giving attackers reconnaissance telemetry.
vulnerabilities.exploitVector: Automated vulnerability scanners search for version strings to execute matching 1-day CVE exploits.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure the web server and application server to strip the Server and X-Powered-By response headers.

vulnerabilities.title: Email Spoofing Risk: DMARC DNS Record Missing
vulnerabilities.description: No DMARC record found for this domain. Email receiving servers cannot verify if emails originating from this domain are authentic.
vulnerabilities.exploitVector: Phishers can forge emails appearing to come from user@google.com to trick employees and clients.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add a DMARC TXT record in your DNS zone with policy p=reject or p=quarantine.
vulnerabilities.fixCode:
# DNS TXT Record for _dmarc.google.com
Name: _dmarc
Type: TXT
Value: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@google.com; pct=100;

scanResult.aiThreatSummary: Security Audit completed for target google.com. Identified 4 security findings across HTTP header configurations, DNS records, and active network ports. Overall posture score evaluated at 45/100.
